text: 【標準答案 Model Answers — 完成所有題目後先好睇！】 Question 1 — Answer: B Model answer: Profit maximisation treats the two projects as identical because both produce the same accounting profit of HK$2.0 million. However, one of the key drawbacks of profit maximisation is that it does not distinguish between receiving a dollar today and receiving a dollar in the future — it ignores the time value of money. A correct financial decision framework (maximising share price/shareholders' wealth by ensuring the total present value of cash inflows exceeds cash outflows) would prefer Project B because of its earlier cash collection. Options A and C are wrong because profit maximisation does NOT capture the time value of money; D is wrong because nothing in profit maximisation would lead to rejecting profitable projects. 【解題思路】: 兩個項目嘅會計利潤一樣（都係 HK$2.0 million），所以以 profit maximisation 為唯一目標嘅話，公司會對兩者無差異（indifferent）——因為呢個目標根本睇唔到現金收取嘅時間先後。呢個正係 Learning Pack 指出嘅第三個缺點：ignores the time value of money。A 錯喺話 profit maximisation「captures」時間價值；C 錯喺兩個項目會計利潤確認時間相同；D 更離譜，利潤最大化唔會拒絕有利潤嘅項目。正確框架（shareholder wealth maximisation）先會因為 Project B 早收錢而揀 B。 Question 2 — Answer: C Model answer: Money markets trade short term debt instruments with maturities of LESS than one year; a nine month corporate bond is therefore a money market instrument. Option A is wrong because the Hong Kong Stock Exchange is a secondary market — trades occur amongst investors and the original issuer receives no money. Option B is wrong because the DJIA is a price weighted index of 30 blue chip companies (excluding transportation and utilities); the market cap weighted 500 company index is the S&P 500. Option D is wrong because the description fits a BROKER, not a dealer; dealers make markets from their own inventory and bear risk. 【解題思路】: 呢題考你對各個市場概念嘅精準記憶。C 正確因為 money market 嘅定義係「maturities of less than one year」嘅債務工具，九個月合資格。A 係經典陷阱——二手市場交易發行公司收唔到錢（二手車比喻）。B 將 DJIA 同 S&P 500 嘅特徵調亂：DJIA 係 30 隻 blue chip、price weighted；500 隻、market cap weighted 係 S&P 500。D 就係 broker 嘅定義，唔係 dealer——記住 dealer 揸貨 bear risk。 Question 3 — Answer: B Model answer: The analyst's strategy relies entirely on publicly available information (annual reports, dividend announcements, management changes). Under the semi strong form EMH, all publicly available information is already reflected in security prices, so analysing it cannot identify mispriced securities or generate abnormal returns after transaction costs — her results therefore contradict the semi strong form. Because the strong form incorporates all information contained in the semi strong form (plus private information), her results also contradict the strong form. The weak form only claims that past price and volume data cannot predict future prices; it does not preclude profits from analysing public fundamental information, so her results are NOT inconsistent with the weak form. 【解題思路】: 關鍵係分析師用嘅資料全部係公開資訊。Semi strong form 話所有公開資訊已經反映喺股價度，分析公開資訊係「pointless」嘅——佢竟然賺到超額回報，即係推翻 semi strong form；strong form 包含晒 semi strong 嘅資訊，所以一併被推翻。Weak form 只講歷史價量數據冇用，佢嘅基本面分析同 weak form 並無衝突，所以 A、C（包 weak form）都錯；D 只講 strong form，漏咗 semi strong form，都錯。記住三個形態係「層層遞增」嘅資訊集合。 Question 4 — Answer: HK$5,765 million Model answer: Total current assets = Inventories 169 + Trade receivables 9,719 + Prepayments and deposits 1,166 + Cash and cash equivalents 6,170 = HK$17,224 million. Total current liabilities = Trade payables 7,426 + Short term bank loans 3,000 + Accruals and other payables 1,033 = HK$11,459 million. Net working capital = 17,224 − 11,459 = HK$5,765 million . The positive figure indicates sufficient short term liquidity (total current assets exceed total current liabilities), consistent with the ABC Entertainment illustrative example. 【解題思路】: 先將資產負債表項目分類：inventories、trade receivables、prepayments & deposits、cash 全部係 current assets；trade payables、short term bank loans、accruals & other payables 全部係 current liabilities。兩邊各自加總後相減：17,224 − 11,459 = 5,765。常見錯誤包括漏咗 short term bank loans（記住短貸係流動負債）、或者漏咗 prepayments & deposits（佢係流動資產）。正數 net working capital 代表短期流動性充足。 Question 5 — Answer: Broker Model answer: Coastal Securities acts as a broker : it brings buyers and sellers together, executes transactions for clients, charges fees, and does not bear any risk of ownership. By contrast, a dealer "makes markets" by buying and selling securities from an inventory it owns and bears the risk that it may not be able to sell a security for more than it paid. 【解題思路】: 題目嘅關鍵字係「on behalf of the client」、「charges a fee」同「never takes ownership」——三個都係 broker 嘅標誌性特徵。如果答案寫「dealer」就錯，因為 dealer 係用自己嘅存貨買賣並 bear risk。考試分辨 broker/dealer 嘅核心問題永遠係：邊個承擔擁有權風險（risk of ownership）？Broker 唔承擔，dealer 承擔。

text: M7 Financial Management — Chapter 1: Financial Environment — Study Pack (Week 1) Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 (Core Learning Objectives) 財務的角色與功能 (Roles and Functions of Finance) ：Finance 是研究資金如何在 lenders（放款人）與 borrowers（借款人）之間流動及配置的學問；同時包含「資金如何被管理」(how money is managed) 及「資金如何取得」(the process of acquiring money) 兩層意義。企業在 start up、operate、expand 三個階段都需要資金，而企業的規模與擁有權結構 (ownership structure) 決定其可用的融資選項——小型企業主要依靠銀行貸款 (intermediated finance)，大型企業則可進入 financial markets 籌資。 財務管理的範疇與目標 (Scope and Objectives of Financial Management) ：分析為何 profit maximisation 不是最佳目標（定義模糊、會計利潤 ≠ 現金流量、忽略 time value of money、忽略風險），以及為何財務經理人的真正目標是 maximise the company's share price ，從而達致 shareholder wealth maximisation 。亦須認識主要財務管理人員：CEO、CFO、Corporate Treasurer 及 CRO 的分工。 金融環境 (Financial Environment) ：了解 financial markets 的功能與分類—— money market vs capital market、primary market vs secondary market、derivatives market、FOREX market ；認識 brokers 與 dealers 的角色分別、 marketability 與 liquidity 的概念、香港金融市場架構 (HKEx、SEHK、Stock Connect、Bond Connect)，以及主要指數 (HSI、S&P 500、NASDAQ Composite、DJIA)。亦要分辨 financial system 與 banking system 及各類 financial intermediaries。 庫務管理 (Treasury Management) ：了解 treasurer 的 roles、treasury department 的 responsibilities 及 activities；掌握 cash budget、cash conversion cycle、float（collection float、disbursement float 及其三個組成部分：transmission / processing / clearing float） 等概念。 效率市場假說 (Efficient Market Hypothesis, EMH) ：掌握 EMH 三種形態（ weak form、semi strong form、strong form ）的資訊內容、對投資者與發行人的 implications，以及對 EMH 的主要批評（包括 behavioural finance 的觀點）。 2. 必背考點清單 (Must Memorize List) A. Profit Maximisation 的四大缺點 (Chapter 核心考點) 1. Ambiguity of "profit" ：利潤定義依會計規則的應用與詮釋而定，可能被扭曲誇大（creative accounting）；亦可透過不投資新設備或延遲維修來壓低今日成本，但損害長遠利益。 2. Accounting profits ≠ cash flows ：收益通常於銷售時確認，早於收現；業主實際需要的是現金（投資及購買貨品服務均需用現金）。 3. Ignores the time value of money ：不區分今天的一元與未來的一元；time value of money 是財務學最重要的概念之一。 4. Ignores risk ：忽略與現金流量相關的風險；投資者是 risk averse，承擔風險須獲得補償，因此風險與預期回報存在 trade off。 正確目標 ：Finance managers aim to maximise the share price of their companies, thereby maximising shareholders' wealth ，方法是作出 investment and financing decisions，確保 total present value of cash inflows total value of cash outflows （重點是 maximise cash flows, not profits）。 B. Financial Markets 的分類速查 市場分類 定義（考試關鍵字） Money market Debt instruments with maturities of less than one year （short term funds） Capital market Equity and debt instruments with maturities exceeding one year （long term funds） Primary market Companies initially sell NEW security issues ；IPO = first time issuance of shares to the public；通常經 underwriter 協助 Secondary market Securities traded amongst investors ；發行公司 不會 從二手交易收到任何款項；活躍 secondary market → 投資者願付更高價 → 公司 funding cost 較低 Derivatives market Contracts derive value from underlying debt/equity securities（如 futures、options） FOREX market Electronic markets for buying and selling currencies，用於減低持有過多某種貨幣的風險 Public market vs Private market 公眾經 stockbroker 買賣 vs 兩方直接交易（private placements） Organised exchange vs OTC market 有實體場所、會員制、席位有限 vs 無中央交易場所、經 dealer 以電話或電腦交易 C. Marketability、Liquidity、Brokers、Dealers Marketability = the ease with which a security can be sold and converted into cash ；取決於 availability of investors 及 transaction costs（trading、search、information costs）——成本越低，marketability 越高。 Liquidity = the ability to convert an asset into cash quickly without loss of value （關鍵分別：liquidity 隱含價值獲得保存，marketability 則沒有此隱含）。 Brokers ：bring buyers and sellers together、代客執行交易、收取費用、 不承擔擁有權風險 (do not bear any risk of ownership) 。 Dealers ：make markets for securities、以自己的庫存 (inventory) 買賣、 必須承擔風險 (bear risk) 。 D. 主要市場指數 (必記數字) Index 關鍵事實 Hang Seng Index (HSI) 1969 年推出； 50 stocks ；free float adjusted； 10% capping 避免單一股份主導；四個分類指數：commerce & industry、finance、properties、utilities；由 Hang Seng Bank 附屬公司發佈 S&P 500 Market cap weighted；500 家美國大型公司；涵蓋約 80% 美國市值；全部成分股必須為 US companies；最少 50% 已發行股份可供交易 NASDAQ Composite 1971 年由 NASD 推出；逾 3,000 隻 NASDAQ 上市股票；強烈 technology focus Dow Jones Industrial Average (DJIA) Charles Dow 於 1896 年創立； 30 家美國 blue chip 公司； price weighted ；包括所有行業 除 transportation 及 utilities ；約佔美國股市價值四分一 E. Financial System vs Banking System 及 Intermediaries Financial system ：連接 lenders 與 borrowers 的系統（直接或經 intermediaries），核心為 financial markets（primary + secondary）。 Banking system ：提供金融服務的機構網絡，重點是促成 indirect market transactions ；banks 是 borrowers 與 lenders 之間的 financial intermediaries。 主要 financial intermediaries ：commercial banks（最大、服務最廣）、life insurance companies、casualty insurance companies、pension funds、investment funds、business finance companies（發行 commercial paper 集資）。 F. Treasury Management 必背 Treasury management = cash management ；現金提供 negligible or no return 且受通脹侵蝕，故企業只持有足以應付到期債務及義務的 最低現金餘額 ；持有過多現金會損失潛在回報。 Cash budget = expected cash receipts and disbursements for the specified period；現金過剩 → 投資或還債；不足 → 減少現金需求、準備借款或作其他應變。 Roles of treasurer （7 項）：maintaining relations with banks；ensuring sufficient cash liquidity；investing surplus funds；understanding funding requirements；understanding available sources of finance；keeping abreast of currency and interest rate risks；monitoring relevant taxes and policies。背後原則： fiduciary responsibility （須永遠以公司最佳利益行事）。 Responsibilities （5 項）：cash forecasting；monitoring working capital；cash concentration（cash sweeps or notional pooling）；investments；risk management（hedging against fluctuations in asset values, interest rates and currency values）。 Cash management 策略 ：加快收款（縮短 accounts receivable period）、延長持有現金（lengthen accounts payable period——但逾期付款有道德及商譽問題）。 Float = 交易中資金傳遞的延誤： Collection float ：付款人發出付款 → 款項 存入 payee 銀行戶口的時間。 Disbursement float ：付款人發出付款 → 款項從付款人戶口 扣除 的時間。 三個組成部分： transmission (delivery) float （付款工具由付款人送至收款人的延誤）、 processing float （收款公司內部處理延誤）、 clearing float （銀行系統結算延誤）。 Treasurer 應設法減少 collection float；pre authorised cheques 可減少 delivery 及 processing delays；zero balance account 只轉入足夠支付當日支票的資金以 maximise float。 G. Efficient Market Hypothesis (EMH) 定義 ：All known information is taken into stock prices immediately upon being known to the public；價格已「price in」所有可得資訊（不論真確與否，包括 rumour or gossip）；因此 不可能 beat the market ，價格只對 新資訊 作出反應。 三種形態（資訊內容遞增，必背層次） ： 1. Weak form ：股價反映所有 過去及公開的市場數據 （歷史價格及成交量）→ technical analysis 不可靠、價格走勢無規律（random movements）。 2. Semi strong form ：反映 所有公開資訊 （weak form 資訊 + earnings、dividends、corporate investments、management changes）→ 分析公開資訊無法找到 mispriced securities； 法律實務採納此形態 ——以私人資訊交易屬不公平，insider trading 被禁止及懲罰（SFC v 案例、 Section 300 of the Securities and Futures Ordinance (SFO) ）。 3. Strong form ：反映 所有公開及私人資訊 → 連 insider information 也無法識別 mispriced securities；已被研究推翻（如 1995 年 Dreman and Berry 研究：low P/E stocks 回報高於 high P/E stocks）。 Implications for investors ：technical analysis 及 fundamental analysis 不大可能在扣除交易成本及稅項後產生 abnormal profits；active trading 不大可能跑贏 passive / buy and hold strategies。 Implications for issuers ：證券發行或回購的 時機不重要 （timing of security issues or share repurchases is unimportant），因價格由市場決定且長期正確；管理層應監察股價變動以辨別其反映新資訊還是短期動量/過度反應。 Criticisms ：(1) 不同投資者對同一資訊有不同詮釋，股票價值難以確定；(2) 現實中投資者回報差異極大，有人能持續跑贏大市（Warren Buffett）；(3) behavioural finance 指出投資者並非全部理性，心理因素（情緒、偏見）影響投資決定。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：Marketability vs Liquidity Marketability Liquidity 定義 證券能否 容易出售並轉換為現金 資產能否 迅速轉換為現金而不損失價值 關鍵差異 不保證 出售時價值得以保存 隱含 出售時價值獲保存 例子：一隻細價股可能每日都有成交、容易賣出（高 marketability），但要套現時可能要大幅折讓（低 liquidity）；兩者日常使用經常互換，但考試問定義時必須區分「without loss of value」這一句。 Pitfall 2：Semi strong form vs Strong form EMH Semi strong form Strong form 價格反映的資訊 所有 公開 資訊（public information only） 所有 公開及私人 資訊（public + private/insider information） 能否靠 insider information 獲超額回報 可以 （故 insider trading 被禁止） 不可以 （連內幕消息也無用） 例子：Betty Young 利用未公開的收購要約資料買入 Hsinchu Bank 股份獲利 HK$2.9 million——她能獲利，證明市場只是 semi strong efficient 而非 strong form efficient（法律亦以 semi strong form 為依據禁止 insider trading）。1995 年 low P/E stocks 跑贏 high P/E stocks 的研究進一步推翻 strong form。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): State the four main drawbacks of profit maximisation as the goal of financial decision making, and identify the appropriate alternative goal. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Ambiguity: "profit" can be defined and manipulated in different ways (creative accounting). Accounting profits are not the same as cash flows (revenue recognised before cash received). It ignores the time value of money (a dollar today vs a dollar in the future). It ignores the risk associated with cash flows (risk–return trade off). Appropriate goal: maximise the company's share price, thereby maximising shareholders' wealth, by ensuring the total present value of cash inflows exceeds cash outflows. [中文白話解釋]: 利潤可以被會計手法「做靚」，又唔等於真係收到現金，仲忽略咗資金嘅時間價值同風險。所以財務經理人嘅正確目標係令股價最大化，繼而令股東財富最大化——重點係 maximise cash flows，而唔係 profits。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): Distinguish between the money market and the capital market, and between the primary market and the secondary market. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Money market: debt instruments with maturities of less than one year (short term funds). Capital market: equity and debt instruments with maturities exceeding one year (long term funds). Primary market: companies initially sell NEW security issues (e.g. an IPO with the help of an underwriter). Secondary market: securities are bought and sold amongst investors; the original issuer receives NO money from these trades; an active secondary market lowers the issuer's funding costs. [中文白話解釋]: 一年係分界線：短過一年嘅債務工具喺 money market 買賣，長過一年嘅（包括股票）喺 capital market。公司首次發行新證券集資係 primary market；之後投資者互相轉手就係 secondary market——好似二手車市場咁，車廠喺二手交易中係收唔到錢嘅。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): ABC Ltd has total current assets of HK$17,224 million and total current liabilities of HK$11,459 million. Calculate its net working capital and explain what it indicates about short term liquidity. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Net working capital = Total current assets − Total current liabilities = 17,224 − 11,459 = HK$5,765 million . Total current assets exceed total current liabilities → the company has sufficient short term liquidity. Positive net working capital indicates the company can meet its short term obligations as they fall due. [中文白話解釋]: 淨營運資金（net working capital）就係流動資產減流動負債。數字為正，即係話公司短期內可以變現嘅資產多過短期內要還嘅錢，短期流動性充足。呢個正係 Learning Pack 入面 ABC Entertainment 個案嘅分析方法。 [Flashcard 4] Front (Question in English): Define collection float and disbursement float, and list the three components of float. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Collection float: the time between when a payer sends payment and the funds are CREDITED to the payee's bank account. Disbursement float: the time between when a payer sends payment and the funds are DEDUCTED from the payer's bank account. Three components: (1) transmission (delivery) float; (2) processing float; (3) clearing float. Treasurers seek to reduce collection float; pre authorised cheques reduce delivery and processing delays; a zero balance account holds just enough funds to cover the day's cheques presented. [中文白話解釋]: Float 係資金喺交易雙方之間傳遞時嘅延誤。收款一方嘅延誤叫 collection float（錢未入到自己戶口），付款一方嘅延誤叫 disbursement float（錢未扣到自己戶口）。三個組成部分記「寄出—處理—銀行結算」：transmission、processing、clearing。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): Compare the roles of a broker and a dealer in secondary markets. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Brokers: bring buyers and sellers together, execute transactions for clients, charge fees, and do NOT bear any risk of ownership. Dealers: "make markets" for securities, buy and sell from an inventory of securities they own, and MUST bear risk (they may not be able to sell a security for more than they paid). Dealers profit the way retailers profit from selling inventory. [中文白話解釋]: Broker 係「中間人」，只負責拉攏買賣雙方、收佣金，唔會揸貨所以冇風險；Dealer 係「莊家」，用自己嘅存貨做買賣，賺買賣差價，所以必須承受存貨跌價嘅風險。考試最鍾意問邊個 bear risk——記住係 dealer。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): State the information content reflected in security prices under each of the three forms of the Efficient Market Hypothesis. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Weak form: all past and publicly known market data (historical price and volume information) → technical analysis is unreliable. Semi strong form: all publicly available information (weak form information + earnings, dividends, corporate investments, management changes) → analysing public information cannot identify mispriced securities; insider trading CAN be profitable (hence banned). Strong form: all public AND private (inside) information → no one can beat the market, even with insider information. [中文白話解釋]: 三個形態嘅資訊層層遞增：weak form 只反映歷史價量數據；semi strong 反映所有公開資訊，但內幕消息仲有用；strong form 連內幕消息都反映晒。法律實務採納 semi strong form，所以先至要禁止 insider trading。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): Match each index with its key characteristics: HSI, S&P 500, NASDAQ Composite, DJIA. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: HSI: launched 1969; 50 stocks; free float adjusted with a 10% capping; most widely quoted gauge of the Hong Kong stock market; four sub indexes (commerce & industry, finance, properties, utilities). S&P 500: market cap weighted; 500 large cap US companies; ~80% of available US market capitalisation; all constituents must be US companies. NASDAQ Composite: launched 1971; over 3,000 NASDAQ listed stocks; strong technology focus. DJIA: created by Charles Dow in 1896; 30 US blue chip companies; price weighted; excludes transportation and utilities; represents about a quarter of the US stock market value. [中文白話解釋]: 四個指數嘅數字要背到滾瓜爛熟：HSI 50 隻、S&P 500 隻（市值加權）、NASDAQ 超過 3,000 隻（科技股）、DJIA 30 隻藍籌（價格加權，唔包運輸同公用事業）。考試常考「邊個係 price weighted」同「DJIA 排除邊兩個行業」。 [Flashcard 8] Front (Question in English): List the five key responsibilities of a treasury department and state the guiding principle behind the treasurer's duties. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: (1) Cash forecasting (aggregating information from budgets, accounting records, board minutes on dividends). (2) Monitoring working capital. (3) Cash concentration (channelling cash into a centralised investment account via cash sweeps or notional pooling). (4) Investments (assigning surplus cash according to the firm's investment policy). (5) Risk management (hedging exposure to fluctuations in asset values, interest rates and currency values). Guiding principle: fiduciary responsibility — the obligation to always act in the firm's best interest. [中文白話解釋]: 庫務部門五大職責記口訣「預測—監控—集中—投資—對沖」。Treasurer 做所有嘢都要以 fiduciary responsibility 為大前提，即係永遠以公司最佳利益行事。另外記住 treasury management = cash management，目標係持有最低但足夠嘅現金，多餘嘅錢要攞去投資。 📝 Phase 3 測驗 ：題目見 M7_Ch1_Financial_Environment_Quiz.md （限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷），完成後先好打開 M7_Ch1_Financial_Environment_Answers.md 對答案！

excerpt: 【標準答案 Model Answers — 完成所有題目後先好睇！】 Question 1 — Answer: B Model answer: Under s.14 of the IRO, a person is chargeable to profits tax where (1) the person carrie…
text: 【標準答案 Model Answers — 完成所有題目後先好睇！】 Question 1 — Answer: B Model answer: Under s.14 of the IRO, a person is chargeable to profits tax where (1) the person carries on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong, and (2) the person derives Hong Kong source profits from that trade, profession or business. Mr Ko carries on a consultancy business through a Hong Kong office (limb 1 met) and his fees arise from services performed entirely in Hong Kong — under the operation test, what he did to earn the profits (performing consultancy services) was done in Hong Kong (limb 2 met). Residence is not relevant to chargeability under the territorial source principle. Option A is wrong: residence does not determine profits tax liability. Option C is wrong: the fees are business profits of his own consultancy business, not income from an employment, office or pension under s.8. Option D is wrong: the withholding basis applies only to a non resident who derives Hong Kong source income (e.g. royalties, entertainers' fees) and has NO Hong Kong business presence; Mr Ko operates through a Hong Kong office, so he reports and pays profits tax himself. 【解題思路】第一步認出呢條係考 s.14 two limbed test：「喺香港經營業務」+「港源利潤」，兩項齊就要交 profits tax。第二步用 operation test 確認來源：服務全部喺香港做，利潤梗係港源。Distractor 分析：A 係經典陷阱——香港睇 source 唔睇 residence，非居民一樣要交稅；C 錯因為佢係自己經營業務而唔係受僱；D 錯因為 WHT 只適用於喺香港 無業務存在 嘅非居民收 royalties／演藝費，Mr Ko 喺香港有辦公室，應自行報稅。 Question 2 — Answer: C Model answer: Decisions of the courts of Hong Kong are binding on the lower courts under the doctrine of precedent: a decision of the Court of Final Appeal binds the Court of Appeal, the Court of First Instance and the Board of Review. Option A is wrong: DIPNs set out the IRD's interpretation and practice but have no legally binding effect (see also BOR D54/06). Option B is wrong: Board of Review decisions are persuasive only and not binding, even on other BoR cases. Option D is wrong: decisions of courts of other common law jurisdictions (e.g. Australia) are generally persuasive rather than binding (only the highest UK courts' decisions, especially pre 1997, are often treated as binding in practice). 【解題思路】呢題考「法律淵源約束力」呢個必考位。記住：statute、DTA、香港上級法院判決 = binding；DIPN = IRD 實務指引，無約束力；Board of Review 裁決 = 只具說服力，連其他 BoR 案都唔綁；海外普通法案例 = 說服力（唯獨 1997 年前英國最高法院判決實務上常被視為有約束力，但題目講澳洲，所以 D 一定錯）。所以唯一 binding 係 CFA 判決。 Question 3 — Answer: B Model answer: There is no withholding tax on Hong Kong source dividends and interest income. Interest paid to a non resident person is chargeable to profits tax only where that non resident carries on business in Hong Kong and derives the interest from Hong Kong — and even then it is reported and paid by the non resident itself, not withheld. Option B is therefore NOT correct. Option A correctly describes the schedular system (separate assessments under salaries tax, property tax and profits tax unless personal assessment is elected). Option C correctly states the IRD's 'assess first, audit later' (AFAL) approach, under which assessments are issued based on returns submitted. Option D correctly reflects Basic Law Article 106 (Hong Kong has independent finances; the Central People's Government shall not levy taxes in the HKSAR). 【解題思路】揀「NOT correct」題要逐項驗證。B 係答案：香港對股息同利息 完全無 WHT ，只有 royalties（在港使用 IP）同非居民演藝／運動員演出費先按預扣基準課稅——呢個係全章最高頻陷阱。A、C、D 全部係 source 白紙黑字嘅正確描述（schedular system、AFAL、Basic Law Article 106），係干擾項。考試貼士：見到 "withhold" 加 "interest/dividend" 嘅組合，八成都係錯。 Question 4 — Answer: HK$742,500 Model answer / Working: First HK$2,000,000 of assessable profits @ 8.25% = HK$165,000 Remaining HK$3,000,000 (HK$5,000,000 − HK$2,000,000) @ 16.5% = HK$495,000 Profits tax payable = HK$165,000 + HK$495,000 = HK$742,500 【解題思路】兩級制利得稅計算：第一步，公司首 HK$2 million 應評稅利潤用 8.25%（= HK$165,000）；第二步，超出 HK$2 million 嘅 HK$3 million 用標準稅率 16.5%（= HK$495,000）；第三步加埋 = HK$742,500。常見錯誤：(1) 全部利潤直接用 16.5%（會錯得 HK$825,000）；(2) 用錯非公司業務稅率 7.5%/15%（題目講明 corporation）；(3) 分界額記錯（係 HK$2 million，唔係 HK$1 million）。考試貼士：睇清楚題目係 "corporation" 定 "unincorporated business" 先落筆。 Question 5 — Answer: HK$43,200 Model answer / Working: Assessable value (AV) = HK$30,000 × 12 = HK$360,000 Less: 20% statutory allowance for repairs and maintenance = HK$72,000 Net assessable value (NAV) = HK$360,000 × 80% = HK$288,000 Property tax payable = HK$288,000 × 15% = HK$43,200 【解題思路】物業稅三部曲：AV（全年租金）→ 扣 20% 法定維修免稅額得 NAV → 乘 15% 標準稅率。即 HK$360,000 × 80% × 15% = HK$43,200。題目特登講 Ms Lee 係 non resident——呢個係煙幕，因為 residence 對物業稅完全無關，只要物業喺香港就課稅（IRO s.5）。常見錯誤：(1) 唔記得扣 20%（錯得 HK$54,000）；(2) 以為非居民免稅（錯）；(3) 誤用累進稅率（嗰個係 salaries tax）。記住物業稅永遠係單一標準稅率 15% 乘 NAV。 【考試貼士】本章 OTQ 高頻考點排序：① territorial source principle vs residence；② s.14 two limbed test + operation test；③ 兩級制利得稅率 8.25%/16.5%、7.5%/15%；④ 無 WHT on dividends & interest（只有 royalties/演藝費）；⑤ DIPN 無約束力；⑥ Basic Law Articles 106/108；⑦ property tax = 15% × 80% AV；⑧ s.51C/s.51D 七年紀錄。全部都可以「一題一分」形式出現，溫書時用 flashcards 反覆自測。

text: M9 Principles of Taxation — Chapter 1: Key Aspects of the Tax System in Hong Kong — Study Pack (Week 1) Source: HKICPA QP Associate Level, Learning Pack (4th edition), Chapter 1. 考試模式提醒：由 2025 年 12 月考期起，M9 為 2 小時 30 分鐘、100% Objective Type Questions (OTQs)、閉卷機考。本章多以「Identify which of the following…」形式考核定義、稅率、條文編號同法律淵源。 Phase 1: Core Concepts & Formula Cheat Sheet 重點梳理與速查表 1. 核心知識架構 (Core Learning Objectives) 描述香港稅制的基本特徵 (Describe the Hong Kong tax system) ：香港實行「地域來源原則」(territorial source principle) 同「分類稅制」(schedular system)——只對源自香港的收入徵稅，並將收入分入三個稅表 (three taxing schedules)：物業稅 (property tax)、薪俸稅 (salaries tax)、利得稅 (profits tax)；除非納稅人選擇個人入息課稅 (personal assessment)，否則三類收入分開評稅。 解釋地域來源原則 (Explain the territorial source principle) ：判斷應否課稅的關鍵是收入的「來源」(source) 而非納稅人的「居民身份」(residence)。IRO s.5（物業稅）、s.8（薪俸稅）、s.14（利得稅 two limbed test + operation test）分別訂明三個稅表的來源規則。 識別香港各類稅項 (Describe the types of taxes) ：直接稅 (direct taxes) 依 IRO 徵收（profits tax / salaries tax / property tax）；印花稅 (stamp duty) 依 SDO 徵收，屬對文書 (instruments) 徵收的間接稅；香港 不設 estate duty、payroll、turnover、sales、value added、gift、dividend 及 capital gains taxes。 描述香港稅法淵源 (Describe the sources of tax law) ：成文法 (statutory law — IRO 及附屬法例)、雙邊稅務協定 (DTAs)、案例法 (case law，包括 Board of Review 裁決)；DIPNs 只屬 IRD 的實務指引， 無法律約束力 (not legally binding)。 說明《基本法》與稅務的關係 (The Basic Law) ：《基本法》是香港稅制之憲制來源；Article 106 / 108 確立香港獨立稅制及稅收不上繳中央人民政府；DIPN 29 概述「一國兩制」下香港與內地的稅務關係。 2. 必背考點清單 (Must Memorize List) A. 稅制特徵 (System Features) Territorial source principle ：一般只有香港來源收入 (Hong Kong source income) 才須課稅；居民身份 (residence) 對香港本地稅務而言 不相關 ，只在應用 DTA 時相關。 Schedular system ：收入不屬任何稅表即無須課稅 (income not within any schedule is not subject to tax)。 Year of assessment ：由 4 月 1 日起至翌年 3 月 31 日止；basis period 通常為該課稅年度內結算的財政年度（profits tax），而 property tax / salaries tax 的 basis period 即 1 April – 31 March。 香港不徵收 ：estate duty、payroll、turnover、sales、value added、gift、dividend、capital gains taxes。 資本增值 (Capital gains) ：長期投資收益（包括外匯收益）一般屬資本性質，不課稅；但短線買賣性質的收益屬交易收入 (trading income)，若源自香港且業務在港經營，須繳 profits tax。 DTAs ：香港已與約 40 個司法管轄區簽訂 comprehensive DTAs；DTA 的主要作用是 分配徵稅權 (allocate taxing rights) 以避免雙重徵稅；DTA 只適用於締約雙方，不及於第三方。 B. 來源規則與條文 (Source Rules & IRO References) 稅項 條文 來源規則 Property tax IRO s.5 位於香港的土地／樓宇使用權收入；物業在香港即屬港源 Salaries tax IRO s.8 香港受僱 (Hong Kong employment) 的收入；判斷受僱來源三因素：(1) residence of the employer；(2) place where the employment contract is negotiated, concluded and enforceable；(3) place of payment of the employment income Profits tax IRO s.14 Two limbed test（兩項須同時符合）：(1) the person must carry on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong；(2) the person derives Hong Kong source profits from that trade, profession or business Operation test（判斷利潤來源） ：看納稅人「做咗啲乜嚟賺取利潤、喺邊度做」(what the taxpayer has done to earn the profit, and where)；只考慮最直接導致利潤的業務運作，純屬先行或附帶 (antecedent or incidental) 的事項不計。例：在日本製造汽車、香港只有後勤開票部門 → 利潤源自日本。 C. 稅率 (Rates — 2018/19 課稅年度起，照 source 所載) Profits tax（two tiered rates, from year of assessment 2018/19, subject to certain conditions） ： Corporations：首 HK$2,000,000 assessable profits @ 8.25% ；超過部分 @ 16.5% Individuals / unincorporated businesses：首 HK$2,000,000 @ 7.5% ；超過部分 @ 15% Salaries tax ：net chargeable income（扣除 deductions 及 allowances 後）按累進稅率 2% → 6% → 10% → 14% → 17% （分層：1–50,000 / 50,001–100,000 / 100,001–150,000 / 150,001–200,000 / above 200,000）；最終稅額為「累進稅率計法」與「未扣 allowances 的收入 × 標準稅率 15%」兩者 較低者 。香港 無 PAYE 制度 ，稅款分兩期繳：首期 75%（課稅年度最後一季到期），餘下 25% 於年度完結後不久到期。 Property tax ：標準稅率 15% ，按 net assessable value (NAV) 計算： NAV = Assessable Value (AV, 一般即租金收入) − 20% statutory allowance for repairs and maintenance 。公司持有並出租香港物業，按 IRO s.2 被視為在港經營業務，同時受 profits tax (s.14) 及 property tax 規範；為避免雙重徵稅，可選擇豁免物業稅只繳利得稅或申請退稅。 Stamp duty（SDO） ：屬 ad valorem，對 文書 (instruments) 而非交易本身 徵收；三大類應課稅交易：買賣香港不動產、租賃香港不動產、轉讓香港股票 (Hong Kong stock)。 不動產 AVD 按價格或價值（以較高者為準）累進徵收；住宅物業於購入後 36 個月內 轉售另徵 Special Stamp Duty (SSD)；非香港永久性居民 (non HKPR) 購入住宅物業另徵 Buyer's Stamp Duty (BSD)。 香港股票轉讓印花稅：按股票價值或轉讓代價（以較高者為準）劃一徵收，稅率由 0.2% 於 2021 年 8 月 1 日起提高至 0.26% （source 原文同時標示 0.2%，考試以 Learning Pack 為準）。 「Hong Kong stock」一般包括：在香港註冊成立公司的股份，以及海外註冊但在香港聯交所上市的公司股份。 D. Withholding Tax (WHT) 香港對 dividends 及 interest 不設 WHT （即使其他國家對跨境股息利息設 WHT）。 只有特定付款按預扣基準 (withholding basis) 課 profits tax，例如：支付予非居民的 特許權使用費 (royalties) （在香港使用知識產權，包括 trademarks, patents, copyright materials）及支付予 非居民演藝人員或運動員 在港演出的費用；由付款的香港居民代非居民報稅並預扣。若收款人所在地與香港簽有 DTA，WHT 可減免。 E. 居民身份 (Residence) — 僅供 DTA 用途 Body corporate ：在香港註冊成立，或在香港受中央管理及控制 (centrally managed and controlled in Hong Kong)。 Individual ：通常居於香港 (ordinarily resides in Hong Kong)，或在一個課稅年度內在港逗留 超過 180 天 ，或在兩個連續課稅年度（其一為有關年度）在港逗留 超過 300 天 。 F. 稅法淵源與約束力 (Sources of Law & Doctrine of Precedent) Statutory law ：IRO 及其附屬法例（直接稅）；SDO（印花稅等間接稅）。 Case law ：香港法院判決對下級法院有約束力——Court of Final Appeal 的判決約束 Court of Appeal、Court of First Instance 及 Board of Review；Court of First Instance 的判決只約束 Board of Review。 Board of Review 裁決不具約束力，只具說服力 (persuasive)；其他普通法地區（英國、澳洲、新加坡、新西蘭）法院判決一般只具說服力，但 英國最高法院判決（尤其 1997 年前）實務上常被視為有約束力 。 DIPNs ：IRD 發出的實務詮釋， 無法律約束力 （BOR D54/06, para. 25），但 IRD 一般會遵循；DIPN 29 概述香港與內地稅務關係（「一國兩制」），依 Basic Law Article 151 香港已簽訂約 40 份 DTAs（截至 2019 年 6 月）。 G. 《基本法》稅務條文 (Basic Law Articles) Article 5 ：社會及經濟制度維持不變（50 年，至 2047）。 Article 8 ：回歸前法律予以保留。 Article 73 ：立法會有權批准稅收政策。 Article 106 ：香港財政獨立，收入只用於香港， 不上繳中央人民政府 ；中央人民政府不得在香港徵稅。 Article 107 ：量入為出，力求收支平衡，避免赤字。 Article 108 ：香港實行 獨立稅收制度 ，參照以往低稅政策，自行立法規定稅種、稅率、減免及豁免。 Article 151 ：香港可以「中國香港」名義自行與外國／地區及國際組織締結協議（經濟、貿易、金融等領域）。 Article 153 ：中國締結的國際協議是否適用於香港，由中央人民政府按情況決定並徵詢港府意見。 H. 納稅人義務 (Taxpayer Obligations under the IRO) 依評稅主任通知在合理時間內提交報稅表及資料 — ss.51(1), 51(2A), 51(3), 51(4), 51(4A) 等 課稅年度基期結束後 不超過 4 個月 內通知其應課稅責任 — s.51(2) 收入停止後 1 個月內 通知 — s.51(6) 離港超過 1 個月，須於預計離港日期 至少 1 個月前 通知（因受僱／業務頻繁離港者除外）— s.51(7) 更改通訊地址後 1 個月內 通知 — s.51(8) 保留英文或中文 業務紀錄不少於 7 年 （交易完成後起計）— s.51C； 租金紀錄不少於 7 年 — s.51D 舉證責任在納稅人 (burden of proof lies with the taxpayer)：須證明 CIR 的評稅過高。 上訴渠道：先向 Board of Review （稅務上訴委員會）提出；不服評稅須於評稅通知書日期後 1 個月內 向 CIR 提交反對通知 (notice of objection)；法律觀點可上訴至 Court of First Instance → Court of Appeal（須許可）→ Court of Final Appeal。 I. IRD 架構與實務 (IRD Structure & Practice) IRD 隸屬 財經事務及庫務局 (Financial Services and the Treasury Bureau)，是其轄下九個部門之一；由 Commissioner 及兩位 Deputy Commissioner (Technical / Operations) 管理 六個單位 （Unit 1–4 + Commissioner's Unit + Headquarters Unit）。 Assess First, Audit Later (AFAL) ：先按報稅表發出評稅，其後才審計。 Advance rulings ：交易進行 之前 （非報稅前）可向 CIR 申請預先裁定；一經作出對 CIR 具約束力；須繳付固定費用。 J. 條文詮釋規則 (Interpretation Rules) 1. 一般條文與特定條文不一致時， 特定條文優先 (specific provision prevails)（例：餐廳一般按 s.24(1) 作業務課稅，但非牟利廚師／餐飲業社團按 s.14 下會社特別處理）。 2. 上級法院判決為最終，凌駕下級法院。 3. IGCO s.19 ：法規不清晰時，須作「fair, large and liberal construction and interpretation」，以保存法律精神及立法原意 (legislative intention)。 4. 五步詮釋法：Step 1 查 IRO s.2 / IGCO Part II s.3 定義 → Step 2 字面／字典釋義 (literal meaning) → Step 3 查相關 DIPNs → Step 4 查相關案例 → Step 5 考究立法原意 (legislative intention)。稅務法庭語言為英文。 3. 易混淆概念對比 (Common Pitfalls) Pitfall 1：「Residence（居民身份）」 vs 「Source（收入來源）」 香港稅制以來源徵稅：「residence is not relevant to domestic HK taxation; source is everything」。 對比：非居民在香港經營業務賺取港源利潤 → 須 繳 profits tax；香港居民賺取海外利潤 → 不須 繳香港稅。 簡單例子：一位居住日本的個人將其 香港物業 以月租 HK$15,000 出租 — 即使業主是海外居民，租金來自香港物業，仍須繳 property tax （15% × 80% NAV）；反之 Mr Wong 的奧地利 ski chalet 租金來自海外，香港不收稅（但可依 HK–Austria DTA Article 6 在奧地利課稅）。居民身份只在應用 DTA（如逗留 180 天測試）時才有意義。 Pitfall 2：「DIPNs」 vs 「具約束力的法律淵源」 DIPNs 由 IRD 發出，解釋其對稅法的理解與實務， 並非法律淵源、無法律約束力 （not legally binding，BOR D54/06 亦確認）；但 IRD 極少不依循。 對比：IRO／SDO（statute）、DTAs、香港法院判決（尤其 CFA 判決）→ 具約束力 ；Board of Review 裁決、澳洲法院判決 → 只具說服力 ；1997 年前英國最高法院判決 → 實務上常被視為有約束力。 簡單例子：納稅人與 IRD 就某條文理解有分歧時，納稅人可依案例法上訴至 Board of Review／法院推翻 IRD 在 DIPN 的觀點——因為 DIPN 不約束法庭；但 CIR 作過的 advance ruling 反而對 CIR 有約束力。記住：「DIPN guides; statute and court precedents bind」。 Phase 2: Bilingual Flashcards 雙語記憶閃卡 [Flashcard 1] Front (Question in English): What are the two key features of the Hong Kong tax system, and what are the three taxing schedules? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Territorial source principle – only Hong Kong source income is chargeable to tax; offshore income generally exempt. Schedular system – income is allocated to three schedules: (1) property tax; (2) salaries tax; (3) profits tax; income outside all schedules is not taxed. Unless personal assessment is elected, each type of income is assessed separately. [中文白話解釋]: 香港只向「香港嚟嘅收入」徵稅（睇來源、唔睇居民身份），而且唔同類型收入分開放入三個稅表各自評稅；邊類都唔啱嘅收入（例如資本增值、股息）就完全唔使交稅。 [Flashcard 2] Front (Question in English): State the two limbed test under s.14 of the IRO for a person to be chargeable to profits tax, and the test used to determine the source of profits. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Limb 1: the person must carry on a trade, profession or business in Hong Kong; and Limb 2: the person must derive Hong Kong source profits from that trade, profession or business. BOTH limbs must be satisfied; residence is not relevant. Source of profits: the 'operation test' – look at what the taxpayer did to earn the profit and where; ignore antecedent or incidental matters. [中文白話解釋]: 利得稅要兩個條件同時成立：第一，你喺香港做生意／執業；第二，你嘅利潤係源自香港。判斷來源用「operation test」——睇你實際做咗啲乜嚟賺錢、喺邊度做；好似香港只有後勤開票部門嗰啲附帶活動係唔算嘅。 [Flashcard 3] Front (Question in English): What are the two tiered profits tax rates applicable from the year of assessment 2018/19? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Corporations: 8.25% on assessable profits up to HK$2 million; 16.5% on any part of assessable profits over HK$2 million. Unincorporated businesses / individuals: 7.5% on the first HK$2 million; 15% on the excess. Subject to certain conditions. [中文白話解釋]: 記住四個數：公司 8.25% / 16.5%，非公司業務（個人獨資、合夥）7.5% / 15%，分界線係首 HK$2 million 應評稅利潤；超過 HK$2 million 嗰部分先用返標準稅率。 [Flashcard 4]（計算卡） Front (Question in English): An individual lets a Hong Kong residential flat for HK$20,000 per month for the whole year of assessment. Compute the property tax payable. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Assessable value (AV) = HK$20,000 × 12 = HK$240,000 Less: statutory allowance for repairs and maintenance = 20% × HK$240,000 = HK$48,000 Net assessable value (NAV) = HK$192,000 (i.e. 80% of AV) Property tax = NAV × standard rate 15% = HK$192,000 × 15% = HK$28,800 [中文白話解釋]: 物業稅好簡單：全年租金（AV）先打八折（扣 20% 法定維修免稅額）得出 NAV，再乘 15% 標準稅率。記住個人業主出租香港物業係交 property tax，唔係 profits tax；而且業主住喺邊度完全無關係。 [Flashcard 5] Front (Question in English): Which cross border payments made by a Hong Kong person to a non resident are subject to withholding tax in Hong Kong, and which are not? Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Subject to WHT (profits tax on a withholding basis): royalties paid to non residents for the use of intellectual property (trademarks, patents, copyright materials) in Hong Kong; fees paid to non resident entertainers or sportsmen for performances in Hong Kong. NOT subject to WHT: Hong Kong source dividends and interest income. WHT on royalties may be reduced or eliminated under an applicable DTA; the Hong Kong payer files the return and withholds tax on behalf of the non resident. [中文白話解釋]: 香港只有兩類付款要預扣稅：畀非居民嘅 royalties（喺香港用 IP）同埋畀海外演藝人員／運動員喺香港演出嘅酬金。股息同利息係完全無 WHT 嘅——呢點同好多國家唔同，係常考陷阱。 [Flashcard 6] Front (Question in English): List the sources of Hong Kong tax law and state the binding status of each. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Statutory law (IRO + subsidiary legislation; SDO) – binding. DTAs – binding between the contracting jurisdictions (approx. 40 for Hong Kong). Case law: Hong Kong court decisions bind lower courts (CFA binds CA, CFI and BoR; CFI binds BoR only); pre 1997 UK highest court decisions often treated as binding in practice; other common law jurisdictions' decisions persuasive only. Board of Review decisions – NOT binding, persuasive only. DIPNs – NOT legally binding; IRD's interpretation and practice only. [中文白話解釋]: 記住等級：法例 香港上級法院判決 其他。DIPN 同 Board of Review 裁決都係「參考用」、無約束力；英國普通法案例一般只係說服力，但 1997 年前英國最高法院判決實務上近乎有約束力。 [Flashcard 7] Front (Question in English): State the taxpayer's record keeping and notification obligations under the IRO (with section references). Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: Keep business records (English or Chinese) for not less than 7 years after completion of the transactions – s.51C; rental records likewise for 7 years – s.51D. Notify chargeability to tax not later than 4 months after the end of the basis period – s.51(2). Notify cessation of income within 1 month – s.51(6); notify departure from Hong Kong for more than 1 month at least 1 month before departure (frequent business travellers excepted) – s.51(7); notify change of address within 1 month – s.51(8). Burden of proof in an enquiry/audit lies with the taxpayer. [中文白話解釋]: 數字口訣：「7 年紀錄、4 個月報稅責任、1 個月報停止收入／改地址／離港預告」。記住購買香港物業本身係唔需要通知 IRD 嘅（常考干擾項），仲有舉證責任喺納稅人身上。 [Flashcard 8]（計算卡） Front (Question in English): Golden Lotus Limited, a Hong Kong corporation, earns Hong Kong source assessable profits of HK$3,000,000 in the year of assessment. Assuming the two tiered rates apply, compute its profits tax payable. Back (Answer & Explanation): [English Point form Answer]: First HK$2,000,000 × 8.25% = HK$165,000 Remaining HK$1,000,000 × 16.5% = HK$165,000 Total profits tax payable = HK$330,000 Dividends distributed by Golden Lotus Limited to its shareholder are exempt (no dividend tax / no WHT on dividends in Hong Kong). [中文白話解釋]: 兩級制計法：首 HK$2m 用 8.25%，淨低嘅 HK$1m 用 16.5%，加埋 HK$330,000。留意股東之後收股息係完全免稅——香港無股息稅，股息（無論港資定海外公司派）一般都唔課稅。 📝 Phase 3 測驗 ：題目見 M9_Ch1_HK_Tax_System_Quiz.md （限時 12.5 分鐘・閉卷），完成後先好打開 M9_Ch1_HK_Tax_System_Answers.md 對答案！
